####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the convergence and WAIC of the models 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$figures <- "../figures"
```

# Check convergence (Rhats) of the photoperiod models ==============================================
```{r}
# Check that Rhats < 1
rhats <- bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                                     "all|archiv", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
         Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
  select(mod, Rhat_cond)

rhats
# Save it 
saveRDS(rhats, glue("{dirs$rhats}/all_rhats.rds"))
```

# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
```{r}
# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
bind_rows(lapply(filter(rhats, Rhat_cond == FALSE)$mod, 
                 function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/rhats_{x}")))) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1)) %>%
  filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
  select(mod, coefficient, Rhat)

# Multi dtpw 4 (not a problem)
## Without country now dtpw 3 (not a problem)
# Multi hib-men 2, 3, 4, 6 (lack of data, nothing to do) (same)
## WC same
# Multi ipv 3 (not a problem)
## WC solved for all 
# Multi opv cs, 2, 3, 4, 6 (lack of data, nothing to do)
## WC same
# Multi strep all (vac conc and vac name) (improved to 2, 3, 4, 6)
## WC improved to 3, 4, 6 
# Multi dtpa all (Tetanus seems to be the problem) (improved to just 2, 3, and 6)
## WC back to all 
```

# Check WAIC of the photoperiod models =============================================================
```{r}
# Read in the waic of the models that converged
waic_df <- bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$waic}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                         "archiv|all", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  select(mod, Estimate_waic) %>%
  rename(waic = Estimate_waic) %>%
  mutate(pat = sub(".*s08_(.*?)_(base|cs|csi).*", "\\1", mod),
         mod_name = str_remove_all(str_remove(string = mod, pattern = pat), 
                                   "bmvl_s08__|bmv1_s08__|_gauss.rds|.rds"),
         vac = sub(".*bmv(.*?)_s08(.*?)_.*", "\\1\\2", mod)) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names) %>%
  left_join(rhats, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])

waic_df
# Save it 
saveRDS(waic_df, glue("{dirs$waic}/all_waic.rds"))
```

# Check waic table per pathogen
```{r}
waic_l <- sapply(unique(waic_df$pat), function(x) filter(waic_df, pat == x), simplify = FALSE)
waic_l$rota

# Check best for each pathogen
waic_best <- waic_df %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(waic_base = waic[mod_name == "base"]) %>%
  arrange(pat, waic) %>%
  mutate(waic_best = waic[1]) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic_base - waic_best) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(pat, mod, delta_waic, waic_base, waic_best, vac)
```

# Plot waic comparisons 
```{r}
pl_waic <- waic_df %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy, levels = pat_tidy_names$pat_tidy)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "red","red", "red", "red")) +
  facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) 

pl_waic
ggsave(pl_waic, file = glue("{dirs$figures}/mod_waic.pdf"), height = 7, width = 11)
```
# Figure 2 =========================================================================================

# Prepare data for the plot 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dtpa", "tetan", "pertu", "ipv", "hib", "men", "strep",
                "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

pred_l <- sapply(
  str_subset(waic_best$mod, "multi|ipv2|ipv3|opv|pertuprn|dtpw|pertufha", negate = TRUE), function(x) {
    waic_mod <- waic_df[waic_df$mod == x, ]
    dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/data_brms_{waic_mod$pat[[1]]}_v{waic_mod$vac[[1]]}_s08.rds"))
    mod_reg <- if(str_detect(waic_mod$mod_name[[1]], "reg")) "reg_4"
    as.data.frame(t(readRDS(glue("{dirs$pred}/pred_{x}")))) %>%
      select(1:20) %>%
      bind_cols(data.frame(
        data = dat$imm_val_s1,
        imm_cutoff_s1 = dat$imm_cutoff_s1,
        imm_cutoff_min = min(dat$imm_val_s1),
        reg = if(!is.null(mod_reg)) dat[,mod_reg][[1]] else NA
      )) %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(reg, imm_cutoff_s1, imm_cutoff_min)) %>%
      mutate(type = case_when(name == "data" ~ "2data", .default = "1draw"))
    }, simplify = FALSE)
```


```{r}
pred_df1 <- bind_rows(pred_l[which(str_detect(names(pred_l), c("rota|hav|hbv|dtpa|tetan|pertu|ipv")))], .id = "mod") %>%
  left_join(distinct(waic_df, mod, pat, pat_tidy), by = join_by(mod)) %>% 
  mutate(name_draw = paste0(name,reg)) 

pred_df2 <- bind_rows(pred_l[which(str_detect(names(pred_l), c("hib|men|strep|measl|mumps|rubel|vzv")))], .id = "mod") %>%
  left_join(distinct(waic_df, mod, pat, pat_tidy), by = join_by(mod)) %>% 
  mutate(name_draw = paste0(name,reg)) 

waic_pldf <- waic_df %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel) %>%
  filter(mod_name %in% c("base", "cs", "csi_reg_2", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_6")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(mod_name = factor(mod_name, labels = c(
    "Base", "Seasonal", "Seasonal by latitude (2)" , "Seasonal by latitude (3)", 
    "Seasonal by latitude (4)", "Seasonal by latitude (6)"))) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy, levels = pat_tidy_names$pat_tidy)) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = case_when(delta_waic < 0.5 ~ 0.5, .default = delta_waic)) 

waic_pldf1 <- filter(waic_pldf, pat %in% c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dtpa", "tetan", "pertu", "ipv")) 
waic_pldf2 <- filter(waic_pldf, pat %in% c("hib", "men", "strep", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv"))
```


```{r}
fig2a.1 <- waic_pldf1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0.5, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log2") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) + 
  facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., ncol = 1) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) 

fig2a.2 <- waic_pldf2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0.5, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log2") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) + 
  facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., ncol = 1) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())
```


```{r}
fig2b.1 <- pred_df1 %>%
  filter(type == "1draw") %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, .default = value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) + 
  geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_line(data = filter(pred_df1, type == "2data"), stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +  
  facet_wrap(~pat_tidy, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
fig2b.2 <- pred_df2 %>%
  filter(type == "1draw") %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, .default = value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) + 
  geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_line(data = filter(pred_df2, type == "2data"), stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +  
  facet_wrap(~pat_tidy, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.direction = "vertical")
```

```{r}
## Patch plots together 
fig2 <- fig2a.1 + fig2b.1 + fig2a.2 + fig2b.2 + plot_layout(ncol = 4, widths = c(1,1,1,1))

# Save the plot 
ggsave(glue("{dirs$figures}/fig2.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)
```
